sloka: सशल्यः क्लिश्यते प्राणैर्विशल्यो विनशिष्यति ।इति मामविशच्चिन्ता तस्य शल्यापकर्षणे ॥२-६३-४९॥
transliteration: saśalyaḥ kliśyate prāṇairviśalyo vinaśiṣyati ।iti māmaviśaccintā tasya śalyāpakarṣaṇe ॥2-63-49॥

translations.english: The thought of removing the arrow kept me pondering. If not removed, it will be painful, and if removed, he will die.
